economic_design.model: Large fixed supply with long‑term emission schedule for mining rewards and vesting for investors and contributors
economic_design.details: The maximum supply is 2 billion FIL (FIL_BASE). The genesis block allocation was 10% for fundraising, 15% to Protocol Labs (including team and contributors), 5% to the Filecoin Foundation, and 70% to miners – of which 55% is reserved for storage mining and 15% for a mining reserve【205284677284828†L57-L66】【205284677284828†L75-L90】. SAFT investor tokens vest in tranches: 22% over 6 months, 15% over 1 year, 5% over 2 years and 58% over 3 years【731013319096822†L118-L131】. Protocol Labs’ 300 million FIL and the Filecoin Foundation’s 100 million FIL vest linearly over six years starting at network launch【731013319096822†L132-L134】. Miners receive block rewards continuously, with 25% of each reward immediately available and 75% vesting linearly over 180 days【731013319096822†L118-L124】.

token_design_thinking.power_structures: Decision‑making distributed across Protocol Labs, the Filecoin Foundation and token holders via FIPs; miners influence network parameters through their stake.
token_design_thinking.team: Developed by Protocol Labs under Juan Benet with contributions from a global network of engineers and researchers.

vesting.fundraising_investors: SAFT investors’ tokens vest in tranches: 22% over 6 months, 15% over 1 year, 5% over 2 years and 58% over 3 years from network launch【731013319096822†L118-L131】.

tokenomics.emissions: FIL is minted as block rewards for storage and retrieval miners until the 2 billion cap is reached. No additional tokens are created once the maximum supply is minted.
